question: The objective of Simon Commission was to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**decide India's Political future.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **objective of Simon Commission **was to decide **India's Political future.**
 
• The Simon Commission was appointed by the **British government in 1927** to review the working of the **Government of India Act 1919** and suggest reforms.
 
• The Commission was headed by **Sir John Simon,** a British politician, and included **six other members**, all of whom were British.
 
• The Commission was met with **widespread protests in India** as it did not have any Indian members and was seen as an attempt by the British government to further **strengthen** their hold on India.
 
• The Commission submitted its **report in May 1930,** which recommended limited reforms in the** central government and provincial governments.** However, the recommendations **were not accepted** by the Indian political parties as they did not address the demand for Indian independence.
 
• The failure of the Simon Commission led to the formation of the** Round Table Conferences,** which were aimed at finding a solution to India's political future.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Commission did recommend the establishment of a **separate education department** in the central government to oversee education in India.
 
• Commission did recommend measures to improve the** economic conditions of the people in India,** such as the establishment of a **central bank** and the development of** agriculture and industry.**
